ideas.pitch: A real-time telemetry and predictive performance tracker for ICPC-style programming contests.
ideas.title: CodeRumble Live Contest Analytics Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the organizers and competitive programmers participating in this ICPC Regional-style event by providing instant post-round analytics and submission trajectory visualization.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first browser extension that parses competitive programming problem statements and generates live interactive visual memory models for complex graph and DP problems.
ideas.title: CP-Visualizer: Algorithmic Step-Through Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the IIITDMJ Programming Club audience and contest judges by solving a daily pain point for competitive coders practicing for regionals.

ideas.pitch: A rapid local test-case generator and stress-testing runner for offline programming contests that compares naive vs optimized solutions against random inputs.
ideas.title: Offline Code Sandbox & Stress Tester
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasises a real, working, demonstrable engineering tool built specifically for an offline ICPC-style contest environment.

ideas.pitch: A predictive model analyzing live penalty points and solve-rate velocity during a 5-hour contest to forecast final team standings.
ideas.title: RumbleRank: Automated ICPC Standings Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous data forecasting patterns similar to winning prediction models, adapted dynamically for a live 5-hour hackathon or contest window.

ideas.pitch: An offline portal parsing team submission logs to generate deep insights on teammate workload distribution and time-to-solve bottlenecks.
ideas.title: Submissions Heatmap & Team Synergy Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses multi-person team coordination challenges during a high-pressure 5-hour competitive programming round.
